verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents an official MCP server that gives Claude, Cursor, Copilot and other agents natural-language access to metrics, logs, traces and alerts. It also publishes Agent Skills for generating queries, creating and modifying dashboards, and managing alerts and saved views. Its use-case docs cover NL dashboard creation, post-deploy investigation and alert tuning. However, all natural-language operation goes through an external AI client rather than a built-in assistant, and the evidence is first-party only. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, independent or hands-on confirmation that the NL workflows work as described, and in-depth detail on which operations the MCP tools cover.
